title: Intent Sidecar (Manifold-conformant)
description: Human-authored policy layer over a template manifest. It is the layout-engine's instance of the Manifold realizer contract: it selects a layout_primitive for a scene from GOVERNED intent signals, and binds that scene's ELEMENTS (by element_id) into the layout's slots. TEXT, git-hosted; many sidecars can target one .potx. Bounded three ways by CI: (1) it may only reference layouts/slots the .potx manifest provides; (2) every selection value must be a member of a governed Manifold vocabulary (intent.enum, tone.enum, complexity.enum, visual-type.enum, primitives.registry); (3) every layout it uses must be a registered layout_primitive. Conformance change 2026-07-31: selection no longer fires on ungoverned Script_Normalizer enums, and bindings no longer interpolate free storyboard fields — they select elements, so every filled slot is traceable to an element_id and the render record is keyed by it.

template_ref.description: Pins this sidecar to a specific template manifest / .potx build. sha256 must equal the manifest's template_ref.sha256 — CI fails the PR otherwise.

manifest.description: Path to the template_manifest.json this policy targets.

token_overrides.description: Optional re-skin over the manifest theme. One .potx yields different expressions per sidecar without a new shell. Keys are theme slots or named_palette aliases. (This is the layout-engine's expression.style_ref override channel.)

interaction_defaults.description: Applied to any layout whose registered layout_primitive carries an interaction_primitive.

gating.description: Whether progression waits until all reveal/visited conditions are met.

selection.description: Ordered rules, FIRST MATCH WINS. Each rule is a predicate over a scene's GOVERNED upstream intent signals -> a layout id (which must be a registered layout_primitive). This is the sidecar's realizer routing; it is the same decision the Manifold realization table encodes, expressed as data for one brand shell.

default_layout.description: Layout id used when no selection rule matches. Keeps the engine total (never fails to place a scene).

bindings.description: Keyed by layout id (must exist in the manifest and be a registered layout_primitive). Each binding maps the layout's slots to ELEMENT SELECTORS over the scene's element graph. Filling a slot resolves to exactly one (or, for repeat, N) element_ids; the render record records slot -> element_id, so every pixel is traceable and stale-detectable via source_hash. Bindings never interpolate raw storyboard strings.

when.description: All present conditions AND together; omit a field to ignore it. Arrays mean 'value in set'. Every value here is validated against a governed Manifold vocabulary by ci/validate_sidecar.py.

script_primitive.description: Governed by script.primitives.v1.json (the 11 knowledge-move types). The realizer's primary routing signal.

pedagogical.description: Governed by intent.enum.json > pedagogical. practice/assess/feedback imply an interactive delivery.

requested_interaction.description: Governed by primitives.registry.json > interaction_primitive keys. Replaces the old free 'potential_interaction' enum.

child_count.description: Structural predicate over the scene's child elements (e.g. ListItem count). Replaces the old 'key_concepts_count'.

flags.description: UNGOVERNED escape hatch for semantics the governed axes don't yet capture. CI emits a WARNING for any non-empty flags, and treats a rule that matches ONLY on flags as provisional — the correct fix is to promote a recurring flag into a governed vocabulary.

use.description: Layout id from the manifest (must be a registered layout_primitive) to render this scene with.

selector.description: Selects element(s) from the scene's element graph to fill a slot. Resolves to element_id(s); the taken value is read from the element's source content, never authored inline here.

scope.description: self = the scene node; child/children = direct children; descendant(s) = anywhere beneath. Singular scopes must resolve to exactly one element (CI/runtime error otherwise).

where.description: Filter on governed element facets. All present conditions AND together.

take.description: Dotted path into the selected element to render into the slot. Defaults to the source meaning (content.text). The resolved element_id is always recorded alongside, regardless of take.

order_by.description: For plural scopes: element facet to order by (default structure.sequence_index).

map.description: slot name -> element selector. Each entry resolves a slot to exactly one element_id.

repeat.description: For a repeatable slot: bind a set of sibling elements across N instances of the exemplar. `source` selects the collection (plural scope); `item_map` maps each sub-slot to a selector evaluated relative to each selected element (scope 'self' = that element).

overflow.description: What to do when content exceeds slot constraints. truncate_flag = cut and surface a QA flag rather than silently overflow.
